Traupman 156, 364

bellus, bella, bellum

adjective, declension

pretty, lovely

(vōx sermōnis cotīdiānī: Plaut., Catull.; Cic. in epistulīs)

The light, everyday word, of people and things alike: Traupman’s stolam bellam, a pretty dress (p. 127).

Other words

  • pulcher, pulchra, pulchrum — beautiful

    adjective, declension · also used · classical · Cic. Off. 1.144: ō puerum pulchrum (Lewis & Short); Traupman 149, 278

  • fōrmōsus, fōrmōsa, fōrmōsum — beautiful, finely formed

    adjective, declension · also used · classical · Verg. Ecl. 2.1 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 149, 278

  • venustus, venusta, venustum — charming, graceful

    adjective, declension · also used · classical · Catull. 31.12 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 147: bella et venusta

Examples

  • … et puellae Caeciliae bellissimae salūtem dīcēs

    … and give my love to little Caecilia, the prettiest of girlsCic. Att. 6.4.3

See also cute, nice.
